name: cookvideo-agent
description: Local control-plane CLI coordinating ChatGPT (planner), Claude (implementation engineer), and the CookVideo repository. Kept separate from the CookVideo application.

scripts.inspect: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js inspect
scripts.status: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js status
scripts.task: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js task
scripts.history: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js history
scripts.approve: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js approve
scripts.advance: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js advance
scripts.reset: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js reset
scripts.execute: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js execute
scripts.plan: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js plan
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
